verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code review product: it reviews PRs and local changes, fixes review findings, and builds wikis and analytics. Generating a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design is outside that category. Its only code generation is targeted fixes for review comments, which is not design-to-app generation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design
